title: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B Image-to-Video Landscape (Local, desktop2)
description: Animates a reference image into a short landscape clip using the native ComfyUI Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B model. Proven end-to-end on desktop2 (RTX 3080 10GB).

_meta_operational_notes.gpu: RTX 3080 10GB VRAM; host desktop2 has only 15.8GB system RAM, WSL2 capped at 12GB.
_meta_operational_notes.ram_constraint: Wan 2.2 5B (VAE 1.3GB + umt5 text encoder 6.4GB + UNet) + sampling activations exceed 12GB. Loading uses fp8 UNet + tiled VAE decode to fit.
_meta_operational_notes.free_ram_recipe: Before a render, stop other containers to free RAM (biggest: gitlab ~2.3GB): `docker stop gitlab homeassistant grafana tradepath-app tradepath-minio tradepath-cache tradepath-db`; restart them with `docker start ...` after.
_meta_operational_notes.tested_working: 640x384, length 17, 20 steps, fp8, tiled decode, ALL non-essential containers stopped -> rendered wan22_i2v_landscape_00001_.mp4 (h264, 17 frames) 2026-06-30.
_meta_operational_notes.larger_renders: 832x480 or longer clips need more RAM: either free more (only caddy+comfyui running) or raise WSL2 memory/swap in %UserProfile%\.wslconfig (host is 16GB, so lean on swap).
_meta_operational_notes.i2v_landscape_defaults: scripts/i2v_landscape.py defaults to 832x480/3.5s which exceeds this box; for the wanvideo path pass e.g. `--width 640 --height 384 --duration 0.7s`.
